scenes.headline: How a pocket model learned to rewrite image prompts
scenes.sub: Qwen-Image-2.1's 9B prompt rewriter, distilled into a 0.8B and a 2B.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pear! Qwen-Image-2.1 wants every request rewritten by a big model first. Here's how two small students learned that job.

scenes.label: What's new
scenes.text: The pocket models answer with no system prompt and no thinking. The instructions and the JSON format are in the weights.
scenes.say: The pocket models do the teacher's job with no system prompt and no thinking. It's all in the weights.

steps.say: You type a short request, and the rewriter reads it first.
It returns one line of JSON: a long description of the finished picture, and an aspect ratio.

steps.note: 34 text tokens as typed; 446 from the 0.8B
steps.say: That description joins the sequence all thirty-two blocks process: thirty-four tokens as typed, four hundred and forty-six from the small rewriter.
Without a prefix cache, every denoising step pays for it, at about one point four times the cost.

left.title: The 9B teacher
left.say: The teacher reads a long system prompt, then thinks for about eight hundred tokens before answering.

right.title: The pocket students
right.say: The students get no system prompt, and their template closes the think block. They answer straight away.

items.say: A small model wrote eight thousand seven hundred and ninety-seven synthetic requests.
The nine-B teacher rewrote every one.
A hard filter kept valid rewrites of eighty to four hundred words.
Both students trained on the survivors for two epochs.

scenes.title: Share of requests that reached training
scenes.note: The students saw 11 posters and 5 app screens
scenes.say: That word limit chose the curriculum. About seventy percent of stickers and logos got in, and almost no posters or screens.

scenes.label: Checks the four test requests define
scenes.note: one draw per arm, four prompts, on four CPU cores
scenes.say: On four test renders, the requests as typed passed seven of nine checks. The small rewriter's passed one: each described a different picture.

scenes.text: The students copied the teacher's format, not yet its effect on pictures, and every rewrite lengthens the denoiser's work.
scenes.mark: not yet its effect on pictures
scenes.say: The students copied the teacher's format, not yet its effect on pictures. And every rewrite lengthens the denoiser's work.

recap: A rewriter turns a request into JSON
Students learned it with no prompt, no thinking
scenes.say: To recap: a rewriter describes the picture, the students learned it without a prompt, and a word limit chose their lessons.
